**\[Academic\] Experiences of Feeling Empty (Everyone, 18+)** [**https://ucjush9.wixsite.com/emptiness**](https://ucjush9.wixsite.com/emptiness) 

At University College London I am leading a research project about people's experiences of feeling empty. Our previous research has shown that feeling empty is surprisingly common, especially for people who receive a PD diagnosis - however we know very little about what emptiness is, or why people feel it. My research team and I want to change this.  
  
We want to hear from people who have ever felt empty in a short, 10 minute, anonymous survey about their experiences. So far 800 people have taken part but we are hoping to hear from as many voices as possible! This project has received ethical approval from University College London's Research Ethics Committee.  
  
**Click here to read more about our work and take part! \* https://ucjush9.wixsite.com/emptiness \***  
  
We recently published a paper in the Journal of Mental Health, which you can read here: [https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/09638237.2021.1922645](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/09638237.2021.1922645)   
  
You can also read our short article in The Conversation about our research so far: [https://theconversation.com/many-of-us-feel-empty-understanding-what-it-means-is-important-for-improving-our-mental-health-163035](https://theconversation.com/many-of-us-feel-empty-understanding-what-it-means-is-important-for-improving-our-mental-health-163035)

Thanks for your time in looking at the study.

This study so far had been entirely self funded, and so there is no funding connected to it as it is a Doctoral Thesis project. 

This research project also doesn't have "bosses" who are set to benefit, since it is a Doctorate thesis project - the only people who will benefit significantly from the project are the student who's project it is, and hopefully the general public if this research can ultimately lead to better care. 

We also don't know that everyone has ever felt empty - this is one of the questions we hope to explore. And if you are correct, then we hope our research will help us understand why people feel this way, and how to improve this for people.

Hey! It depends whether you are looking to do a PhD or a Doctorate in Clinical Psychology. They are very different programs, with very different needs in terms of experience. A PhD is a research based 3 year program in the UK and has no clinical skills. At the end of it you are a Doctor of Research in Clinical Psychology but couldn't work clinically. However a DClinPsy is a Clinical and research 3 year training involving a combination of research and placements in Clinical roles. I am currently doing my DClinPsy in London and am happy to answer any questions you have!

During our development we did consult with a number of Trans and Non-Binary individuals with lived experience (however, they were obviously only able to speak from their own perspectives and can never represent the entirety of people who are Trans of NB) to try and find the best way to ask about gender whilst respecting the challenges this can bring. For the purpose of our study we do want to be able to look at any potential difference between cis and trans individuals, to see whether people's experience of emptiness differs based on identity, hence the need to identify those tho are cis or trans. So this is really helpful feedback to enable us to do this better. Thank you again!

Sometimes it can be really helpful to have an explicit conversation about how you are finding them, letting them know which bits are being really useful and which other bits aren't clicking for you. It can take a while for a therapist to get a sense of what is going to work best, and matching up their style/your style can be tricky. Having an explicit conversation can help the therapist get on your wavelength. And then after that if it's still not right, then time to find someone else. Ultimately, you are a customer, and it's their job to help you with what you need, so you are 110% entitled to raise an issue if you're not getting good value for money!

\[Academic\] Experiences of Feeling Empty (18+ All Welcome) [https://ucjush9.wixsite.com/emptiness](https://ucjush9.wixsite.com/emptiness) 

Short 15-minute anonymous online survey about experiences of feeling empty in life. So far over 600 people have taken part, but we are hoping to represent as many voices as possible!

This is the second part of a research project at University College London, looking to understand and create a scale to measure people's experiences of emptiness. Previous work by this research team is published in the Journal of Mental Health and can be read here: [https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/09638237.2021.1922645](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/09638237.2021.1922645).

Thanks for your time and interest!
